user_goal: Make the public streamer/creator brand site feel more cinematic and keep authored hero artwork visible on desktop without harming mobile layout or editing Save/Publish data.

finding.source_of_width: The published Editor Page Model owns the wide copy panel; the presentation override is deliberately CSS-only.

Version the SANCI presentation stylesheet URL to art-reveal-v1 so browsers fetch the published CSS.
Assert SANCI-only selector scope, desktop panel cap, mobile full width and breakpoint rules.
Exercise 320/390/768/1440 widths, hero-art reveal, mobile fit, horizontal overflow and reduced motion.
